chapter_note: Chapter is fundamentally a Manichaean ecclesial teaching about Elect fasting practice — the "four works" accomplished by the fast of the holy ones, with a closing extension to catechumen Sunday fasting/communion. The institutional frame is heavy throughout (holy ones / faithful / Sunday / commune). However, embedded in the second of the four works is a clean cosmological-substrate fragment describing the Living Soul that comes through daily nourishment being purified, cleansed, filtered, and washed of the Darkness mingled into her — this is genuine Living-Soul-in-food cosmology. Editorial fatigue score is high (+5.6) with second-half drift toward ecclesial vocabulary as the editor extends the teaching to catechumen liturgical practice.
